items.exampleEn: The correctness of the final numbers is very important.
items.exampleZh: 最終數字的正確性非常重要。

items.exampleEn: Her performance in the final was flawless.
items.exampleZh: 她在決賽中的表現完美無瑕。

items.exampleEn: I had a queer feeling that someone was watching me.
items.exampleZh: 我有一種奇怪的感覺，好像有人在看著我。
items.glossZh: 奇怪的（本課只教舊義；另為性少數自稱）

items.exampleEn: The old lamp shone weakly in the corner.
items.exampleZh: 那盞舊燈在角落發出微弱的光。

items.exampleEn: Make sure your jacket is waterproof before you go hiking.
items.exampleZh: 去健行前，先確定你的外套是防水的。

items.exampleEn: The size of the universe is almost unimaginable.
items.exampleZh: 宇宙之大幾乎難以想像。

items.exampleEn: The town felt lifeless after the factory closed.
items.exampleZh: 工廠關閉後，這個小鎮變得死氣沉沉。

items.exampleEn: Some fans blindly follow everything their favorite star does.
items.exampleZh: 有些粉絲盲目地跟著他們最喜歡的明星做每一件事。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher checks the correctness of our answers, not our handwriting.
items.sentenceZh: 老師檢查的是答案正不正確，不是字寫得好不好。

items.audioEn: The team played weakly in the first half, but they scored twice after the break.
items.audioZh: 那支球隊上半場表現疲軟，但中場休息後進了兩球。
items.questionZh: 中場休息後發生了什麼事？
options: Two goals went in for them

items.sentenceEn: In the old novel, the empty house had a queer smell of smoke.
items.sentenceZh: 在那本老小說裡，那棟空屋有一股奇怪的煙味。

items.sentenceEn: Twenty years ago, video calls on a phone were unimaginable to most people.
items.sentenceZh: 二十年前，用手機視訊通話對大多數人來說是難以想像的。

items.stemEn: The diamond was ____, without a single mark or scratch.
items.stemZh: 那顆鑽石完美無瑕，一點痕跡或刮痕都沒有。

items.stemEn: Don't ____ believe everything you read on the internet.
items.stemZh: 不要盲目相信你在網路上看到的一切。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my cousin went on a scuba diving trip with a group of friends. Before going, she bought a waterproof camera and checked that every setting was correct. Under the sea, the colors were almost unimaginable: blue fish, yellow coral and bright green plants. But in one area, the coral looked gray and lifeless. Most of her photos came out almost flawless, and she plans to show them at a school talk about protecting the ocean.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我的表親和一群朋友去水肺潛水。出發前，她買了一台防水相機，並檢查每個設定是否正確。海底色彩之豐富幾乎難以想像：藍色的魚、黃色的珊瑚和翠綠的植物。但在某一區，珊瑚看起來灰灰的、毫無生氣。她大部分的照片幾乎都拍得完美無瑕，她打算在學校一場關於保護海洋的演講中展示這些照片。

questions.questionZh: 出發前，作者的表親做了什麼準備？
options: 買防水相機並檢查設定

questions.questionZh: 作者的表親打算怎麼使用這些照片？

items.promptZh: 她跑完長跑後虛弱地笑了笑。
referenceEn: She smiled weakly after the long run.
After the long race, she smiled weakly.
rubricZh: 要用 weakly 修飾動詞（例如 smiled weakly）
「長跑」可寫，例如 the long run、the long race 等
時態合理即可（例如 smiled 等）

items.promptZh: 我的新手機是防水的，所以掉進水裡也沒關係。
referenceEn: My new phone is waterproof, so it is fine if it falls into water.
My new phone is waterproof, so dropping it in water is not a problem.
rubricZh: waterproof 表示「防水的」（例如 is waterproof 等）
「掉進水裡也沒關係」可寫，例如 it is fine if it falls into water 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：寫作者疑慮 queer：現代英語主要是性少數的自稱／（舊時）貶稱，「奇怪的」屬過時用法；B2 學習者照此義使用可能冒犯他人。建議至少在釋義加註「現代多指性少數，描述奇怪請用 strange」，或請執行長考慮換字。
